name: Kentucky: 2018 Kentucky Residential Code, Third Edition (August 2024)

review.note: Adopts IRC 2015 (Kentucky Department of Housing, Buildings and Construction; 815 KAR 7:125). State amendments to the checked rules: riser height, tread depth. Amendments were researched for stairs, ceiling height, light and ventilation only; every other rule (room size, egress, escape openings, electrical, alarms) is the base code's.
